description: A managed user with no library: viewer2 while accessroles-web-guard-probe.mjs manages it with no library (the probe's Kid role, its own library mode Only with nothing, confirmed). /Me says NoLibraries; Home's "Ask an administrator to create a library." is replaced by /Me's message, as text, also after leaving Home and coming back (Home rebuilds it). When a playlist is visible to viewer2, Home shows no such message at all: the run records which. Reads only.

steps.name: the guard has viewer2's /Me: managed, no libraries
what Home shows
steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.homePage:not(.hide) .sections > .centerMessage p'); const sections = [...document.querySelectorAll('.homePage:not(.hide) .sections > *')].map((e) => (e.querySelector('.sectionTitle') || e).textContent.trim().slice(0, 40)).filter(Boolean); return p ? { message: p.textContent, replaced: p.getAttribute('data-jfar-replaced'), elements: p.children.length, sections } : { message: null, sections }; })()

steps.name: the stock message is /Me's, as text (or no message at all, a playlist being visible)
steps.assert: __vars.home.message === null ? true : (__vars.home.message === 'No libraries have been shared with you yet. Ask your server administrator.' && __vars.home.elements === 0)

steps.name: leave Home and come back
steps.script: location.hash = '#/mypreferencesmenu'; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); location.hash = '#/home'; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500)); const p = document.querySelector('.homePage:not(.hide) .sections > .centerMessage p'); return p ? p.textContent : null;

steps.name: replaced again when Home rebuilt it
steps.assert: __vars.home.message === null ? __vars.again === null : __vars.again === 'No libraries have been shared with you yet. Ask your server administrator.'

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
